achievements.title: ACD Martial Arts Sports Club delivered their best performance ever at the 2nd MP State Kickboxing Championship 2026!
achievements.position: Team ACD won 22 medals across 25 events, with outstanding performances.
achievements.description: ACD Martial Arts Sports Club delivered their best performance ever at the 2nd MP State Kickboxing Championship 2026! Team ACD won 22 medals across 25 events, with outstanding performances. Congratulations to the team on this historic victory!

achievements.title: Krati Sethiya proudly represented Team Madhya Pradesh at the Junior National Kickboxing Championship 2026
achievements.description: This is a proud moment for ACD Martial Arts and the entire Mandsaur district as Krati Sethiya proudly represented Team Madhya Pradesh at the Junior National Kickboxing Championship 2026, held from 30th May to 3rd June at KT Global School, Khordha, Odisha. Her participation at the national level reflects dedication, hard work, and the true spirit of sportsmanship.
